name: The majority voted in favour of a [motion](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?id=2019-07-24.79.1) to pass the bill. In parliamentary jargon, they voted in favour of the question: > *that the [Future Drought Fund Bill 2019](https://parlinfo.aph.gov.au/parlInfo/search/display/display.w3p;query=Id:legislation/billhome/r6371), as amended, and the [Future Drought Fund (Consequential Amendments) Bill 2019](https://parlinfo.aph.gov.au/parlInfo/search/display/display.w3p;query=Id:legislation/billhome/r6372) be [read a third time](https://www.peo.gov.au/learning/fact-sheets/making-a-law.html).* ### What do these bills do? The bill was [introduced in order to](https://parlinfo.aph.gov.au/parlInfo/search/display/display.w3p;query=Id:legislation/billhome/r6371) use: > *uncommitted funds from the Building Australia Fund to establish the Future Drought Fund (comprised of the Future Drought Fund Special Account and the investments of the Future Drought Fund) as a dedicated investment vehicle to provide a secure revenue stream to be used for drought resilience, preparedness and response. Also establishes the Future Drought Fund Consultative Committee.*
